id.description: The unique numeric identifier for the product.

title.description: The name or title of the product.

body_html.description: A description of the product in HTML format.

vendor.description: The name of the vendor or manufacturer of the product.

created_at.description: The date and time when the product was created.

handle.description: A unique, human-friendly URL slug for the product.

updated_at.description: The date and time when the product was last modified.

published_at.description: The date and time when the product was published, or null if unpublished.

template_suffix.description: The suffix of the liquid template used to render the product page.

published_scope.description: The scope where the product is published, such as global or web.

tags.description: A comma-separated list of tags associated with the product.

status.description: The publishing status of the product, such as active, draft, or archived.

admin_graphql_api_id.description: The GraphQL API global ID corresponding to the product.

items.description: A specific variant of the product.

variants.description: The list of variants available for this product.

options.description: The custom options available for customizing variants, such as size or color.

items.description: An image associated with the product.

images.description: The collection of media images associated with the product.

image.description: The featured image object for the product, or null if none is set.

description: Response containing details of the requested product.
